policies: fixed target without a forecast edge filter
fixed target with existing adaptive net-edge filter
protocol.entry_and_exit: Unchanged opening decision/100ms IOC response and same-day close sweep; full-target admission required; no new patient execution algorithm.
protocol.selection: Same expanding earlier-session forecasts, 0.5% net buffer, 50% forecast cover support, three issuers and 10%-NAV squeeze reserve as short_adaptive_sizing.v1.
protocol.fees: IBKR Pro Fixed $0.005/share, $1 minimum, 1% notional cap per leg; current SEC 20.60/million sold and CAT 0.000003/share each side. Normal FINRA TAF 0.000195/share sold capped at $9.79 is retained rather than extrapolating the temporary 2026Q4 holiday. Components rounded up to cents per modeled leg.
protocol.fee_basis: Current forward cost sensitivity applied to historical fills; not historically invoiced costs. One modeled order per leg, with no extra minimums for a future sliced execution algorithm.
protocol.financing: Same-day modeled flat: borrow and proceeds interest both zero. Actual locate charges, delayed-cover borrowing and account funding costs unverified.
protocol.overhead: Trading P&L before annual data, infrastructure, labor, capital opportunity cost and tax; report annual overhead break-even, not assumed zero operating expense.
protocol.consistency: Trades, win fraction, losing trades, worst trade, closing-equity dollar drawdown, calendar-year dollars and profit excluding the best trade. No unobserved squeeze extrapolation.
protocol.validation: Retrospective sizing sensitivity after larger-ticket research; all 57 declared variants reported, no winner promoted. Existing designated execution holdout file remains unread.
